age_presentation.target: Infer from user instructions and the primary face reference.

framing: large half-body portrait from hair or headwear top to a natural waist cutoff

waist_anchor.rule: Keep the visible waist line at a stable bottom anchor; a natural waist cutoff is correct.

proportions.face_size_rule: Keep face height stable across all frames and actions.
proportions.eye_line_rule: Keep eye height stable across all frames and actions.
proportions.upper_body_rule: Keep head, shoulders, visible arms, hands, and waist proportion consistent.

style.rendering: clean chibi sticker, rounded dark outline, flat cel shading

forbidden_drift: toddler-like face for an adult subject
face shape, jaw, or midface drift
outfit color, print, or construction drift
face size, eye-line, or waist-anchor drift
extra or missing hands or disconnected arms
unrequested headwear, logos, glasses, or jewelry
